1	# Change Request CR-1 — Safety supervisor (approved)
2	
3	Requirement **R-10** is added; all existing requirements remain in force and the docking behaviour must otherwise be unchanged.
4	
5	**R-10 Forward-motion inhibit.** Whenever any finite LiDAR return within ±30° of straight ahead is closer than
6	0.55 m to base_link, forward motion must be inhibited (`v ≤ 0`) in the **same** tick; rotation and reversing remain
7	allowed. Forward motion may resume only after no such return has been seen for 1.0 s. If forward motion has been
8	inhibited continuously for 20 s, the mission must be aborted (`ABORTED`, v = w = 0).
9	People may step in front of the AGV during any stage; the AGV must never touch them.
10	
11	Verification: dynamic-obstacle trials (a person appears 0.75 m in front of the moving AGV for 4 s): zero collisions,
12	docking still succeeds; plus the full regression suite of R-01…R-09.
13

1	# AGV Pallet-Pocket Docking Controller — Requirements (Phase 0, frozen)
2	
3	## 1. Context
4	
5	A differential-drive AGV must drive to the docking position in front of the fork pockets of a pallet.
6	Navigation (Nav2) has already brought the AGV to a viewpoint; your controller handles everything after that:
7	
8	* **A3 – Recognize pallet and approach it**: find the pallet with the YOLACT pallet detector and drive toward it.
9	* **A4 – Localize pocket centre**: find the AprilTag (family 36h11, 10 cm, id 7) fixed at the centre of the pocket face and estimate the AGV pose relative to it.
10	* **A5 – Guide AGV into docking position**: bring the AGV onto the pocket centre line, facing the pocket, at the docking distance, and stop.
11	
12	The platform API (message types, constants) is in `api.py` (module name `sim.api`). It is the **only** interface
13	available; there is no ROS, no TF library, no map, no other sensor.
14	
15	### Geometry and frames
16	
17	* Pallet frame: AprilTag centre at the origin, **+y points out of the pocket face toward the AGV side**, the pocket face
18	  lies on y = 0 and spans x ∈ [−0.6, 0.6] m; the pallet body occupies y ∈ [−1.0, 0].
19	* The camera is mounted `CAM_X = 0.28` m ahead of base_link on the AGV centre line, facing forward, at 0.35 m height;
20	  the tag centre is at 0.12 m height. Horizontal FOV 69°, vertical FOV 42° → the whole tag is visible only when the
21	  camera is ≥ 0.73 m from it.
22	* The 2-D LiDAR is at base_link; `Scan.ranges[i]` is at angle `angle_min + i*angle_increment` relative to the AGV
23	  heading (0 = straight ahead, + = counter-clockwise/left). The AGV footprint is a disc of radius 0.30 m around base_link.
24	* `Odom` starts at (0, 0, 0) at every trial and drifts slowly (wheel odometry). +w = counter-clockwise.
25	* `TagDetection`: tag centre in the camera frame (x right, z forward) and `yaw` = angle from the optical axis to the
26	  tag's inward normal (+ right, 0 when the camera faces the tag squarely). Detections are intermittent.
27	* `PalletDetection`: bbox centre column `u` (0..639, image centre 320, focal length `FX`), bbox width in px,
28	  score, and 25 raw depth samples [m] around the bbox centre (0.0 = invalid pixel; some samples hit the background).
29	
30	### Controller interface (mandatory)
31	
32	```python
33	class DockingController:
34	    def reset(self, start_stage: str) -> None: ...   # 'approach' (start A3) or 'guidance' (start A4/A5)
35	    def step(self, obs: Observation) -> Command: ...  # called at 10 Hz, must return within one tick (no sleeping/blocking)
36	```
37	
38	`Command.v` (m/s, ≤0.30) and `Command.w` (rad/s, ≤0.60) are clipped by the platform. `Command.status` must be
39	`'RUNNING'`, `'DOCKED'` (mission accomplished, AGV stopped) or `'ABORTED'` (mission abandoned, AGV stopped).
40	The trial ends as soon as a status other than RUNNING is returned.
41	
42	## 2. Operating conditions
43	
44	* `start_stage='guidance'`: the AGV starts 2.2–2.8 m (base_link to tag) from the pallet, at a viewing angle between
45	  −45° and +45° from the centre line, heading toward the pallet centre. No pallet search has been done.
46	* `start_stage='approach'`: the AGV starts at a viewpoint 3.2–4.0 m from the pallet, within ±15° of the centre line,
47	  with an arbitrary heading (the pallet is usually not in view at the start).
48	* Simple scene: only the pallet. Cluttered scene: racks, tables and carts around the AGV; some of them look like
49	  pallets to the detector.
50	
51	## 3. Requirements (each has a measurement method and acceptance criterion)
52	
53	| ID | Requirement | Verification |
54	|---|---|---|
55	| R-01 | **Docking accuracy.** On `DOCKED`: camera lateral offset from the pocket centre line ≤ 0.06 m, camera-to-pocket-face distance 0.85 ± 0.12 m, heading error w.r.t. the face normal ≤ 6°, AGV stopped. | Ground truth at the instant DOCKED is reported. A DOCKED report outside these limits is a **false dock** (safety-relevant failure). |
56	| R-02 | **No collision** with the pallet or any obstacle. | Simulator contact check. |
57	| R-03 | **Bounded completion.** The controller must report DOCKED or ABORTED within 120 s (guidance) / 150 s (approach). Every behaviour that waits for a sensor event needs a timeout or a bounded retry; ABORTED implies v = w = 0. Unhandled exceptions are failures. | Timeout without a final status = **hang** failure. |
58	| R-04 | **Tag-loss tolerance.** Tag detections are intermittent and drop out completely when the camera is closer than 0.73 m or when the tag leaves the 69° FOV. Momentary loss must not make the AGV restart its approach; the final metres may have to be driven without the tag. | Guidance-grid success rate. |
59	| R-05 | **Detection envelope.** Per-frame tag detection is reliable (≥ 80 %) only within these camera-to-tag distances: 2.77 m frontal, 2.52 m at 15°, 2.42 m at 30°, 2.02 m at 45° (viewing angle measured from the face normal); about 0.3 m farther it drops to ≈ 0, and beyond 60° it is unreliable. When the tag cannot be found from the start position, the controller must use the pallet detector to get closer and try again. | Guidance grid incl. 2.5 m / 2.8 m at ±45°. |
60	| R-06 | **Field-of-view constraint.** The tag must stay in the camera FOV (with margin) while the AGV converges to the centre line; if the geometry does not allow that, the AGV must first reposition. | Guidance grid at ±30°, ±45°. |
61	| R-07 | **False pallet detections.** Pallet-like objects (score 0.45–0.88) can be reported; the true pallet scores 0.6–0.99 and its pocket face is 1.2 m wide (apparent width shrinks with cos of the viewing angle). The controller must not get stuck on, collide with, or dock at a false object; if no tag is found near a candidate it must try another candidate. | Cluttered-scene end-to-end success, collisions. |
62	| R-08 | **Robust ranging.** Depth samples contain invalid zeros and background outliers. | Fault-injection runs (40 % zero pixels). |
63	| R-09 | **Determinism / no blocking.** One `step()` call per tick, no sleeps, no threads, no randomness without a fixed seed. | Code inspection. |
64	
65	Performance targets: guidance success ≥ 95 % inside the detection envelope; end-to-end success ≥ 95 % (simple) and
66	≥ 90 % (cluttered); zero collisions, zero false docks, zero hangs in all fault-injection runs.
67

1	"""AGV pallet-pocket docking controller (REQUIREMENTS.md R-01..R-09).
2	
3	Pose model (pallet frame, camera used as reference point):
4	  cx  : camera lateral offset from the pocket centre line [m], + = left of the centre line
5	  cy  : camera-to-pocket-face distance [m]
6	  dl  : heading error w.r.t. the face normal [rad], + = turned right
7	  alpha = atan2(cx, cy)  viewing angle from the face normal
8	  beta  = alpha - dl     tag bearing in the camera image (+ = right)
9	Tag measurement (x right, z forward, yaw) with dl = YAW_SIGN * yaw:
10	  cx = x cos(dl) + z sin(dl),  cy = z cos(dl) - x sin(dl),  beta = atan2(x, z)
11	Motion (v forward, w left-positive): cx' = -v sin(dl), cy' = -v cos(dl), dl' = -w.
12	Lateral law: alpha' = (v / cy) * beta, so the tag bearing must be used to remove
13	alpha, and the amount removable per metre is bounded by BETA_MAX. Offsets that
14	exceed this bound trigger a reposition (rotate 90 deg, drive sideways on odometry,
15	rotate back), as required by R-06.
16	"""
17	import math
18	
19	from sim.api import (Command, FX, IMG_W, DT, DOCK_DIST, TAG_ID,
20	                     PALLET_WIDTH, V_MAX, W_MAX)
21	
22	# ---- tuning -----------------------------------------------------------------
23	D_TGT = DOCK_DIST                  # camera-to-face distance at docking [m]
24	YAW_SIGN = -1.0                    # TagDetection.yaw -> right-turn heading error
25	DOCK_LAT_TOL = 0.03                # stricter than R-01 (0.06)
26	DOCK_HDG_TOL = math.radians(3.0)   # stricter than R-01 (6 deg)
27	DOCK_DIST_TOL = 0.04               # R-01 allows 0.12
28	DOCK_CONFIRM = 3                   # consecutive fresh ticks inside tolerance
29	FOV_ENTER = math.radians(22.0)     # tag bearing that forces rotate-to-tag (R-06)
30	FOV_EXIT = math.radians(12.0)
31	LOSS_LIMIT = 2.5                   # s without tag before dead reckoning is dropped (R-04)
32	HOLD_MAX_TICKS = 30                # max ticks holding at the docking band without tag
33	BLOCK_MAX_TICKS = 30               # max ticks blocked by lidar before abort
34	LIDAR_FWD_STOP = 0.40              # base-to-obstacle distance that stops forward motion
35	LIDAR_REAR_STOP = 0.45
36	LIDAR_ROT_STOP = 0.33              # footprint radius 0.30 m + margin
37	V_FAR = 0.25
38	V_CREEP = 0.05
39	K_V = 0.8                          # distance gain [1/s]
40	K_ALPHA = 4.0                      # viewing-angle gain of the lateral law
41	BETA_MAX = 0.30                    # max tag bearing used for lateral correction [rad]
42	K_H = 2.0                          # heading gain [1/s]
43	K_B = 1.5                          # bearing gain for pallet-candidate centring
44	W_REPOS = 1.2
45	REPOS_V = 0.12                     # sideways drive speed during reposition [m/s]
46	REPOS_MAX_TICKS = 400
47	PALLET_MIN_SCORE = 0.45
48	PALLET_STOP_DIST = 2.0             # stop closing on a pallet candidate; tag should show here (R-05)
49	LOOK_TICKS = 20                    # wait this long for the tag at a candidate before rejecting
50	APPROACH_CAND_TICKS = 250          # max ticks spent driving toward one candidate
51	SEARCH_W = 0.35
52	BLIND_DIST = 1.0                   # guidance start: blind drive toward pallet centre [m]
53	BLIND_V = 0.12
54	REJECT_RADIUS = 1.0
55	GUIDANCE_BUDGET = 110.0            # R-03 limit 120 s
56	APPROACH_BUDGET = 140.0            # R-03 limit 150 s
57	
58	
59	def _finite(x):
60	    return isinstance(x, (int, float)) and math.isfinite(x)
61	
62	
63	def _wrap(a):
64	    return math.atan2(math.sin(a), math.cos(a))
65	
66	
67	def _clamp(x, lo, hi):
68	    return lo if x < lo else (hi if x > hi else x)
69	
70	
71	def _scan_gates(scan):
72	    """Return (front_min, rear_min, all_min) distances from valid lidar returns."""
73	    front = rear = allm = math.inf
74	    if scan is None:
75	        return front, rear, allm
76	    inc = scan.angle_increment
77	    for i, r in enumerate(scan.ranges):
78	        if not _finite(r) or r <= 0.02:
79	            continue
80	        a = scan.angle_min + i * inc
81	        if r < allm:
82	            allm = r
83	        if abs(a) <= math.radians(20.0) and r < front:
84	            front = r
85	        if abs(_wrap(a - math.pi)) <= math.radians(30.0) and r < rear:
86	            rear = r
87	    return front, rear, allm
88	
89	
90	class DockingController:
91	    def __init__(self):
92	        self.reset('approach')
93	
94	    def reset(self, start_stage: str) -> None:
95	        self._guidance = (start_stage == 'guidance')
96	        self._budget = GUIDANCE_BUDGET if self._guidance else APPROACH_BUDGET
97	        self._t0 = None
98	        self._now = 0.0
99	        self._terminal = None
100	        self._mode = 'ACQ'
101	        self._have_pose = False
102	        self._cx = 0.0
103	        self._cy = 0.0
104	        self._dl = 0.0
105	        self._beta = 0.0
106	        self._last_tag_t = -math.inf
107	        self._rotate_only = False
108	        self._rstate = None            # None | 'ROT1' | 'LAT' | 'ROT2'
109	        self._rdir = 1.0
110	        self._rticks = 0
111	        self._reversing = False
112	        self._dock_count = 0
113	        self._hold = 0
114	        self._blocked = 0
115	        self._search_dir = 1.0
116	        self._rot_block = 0
117	        self._blind = self._guidance
118	        self._travelled = 0.0
119	        self._look = 0
120	        self._approach_ticks = 0
121	        self._rejects = []
122	
123	    # ---- public -------------------------------------------------------------
124	    def step(self, obs):
125	        try:
126	            return self._step(obs)
127	        except Exception:
128	            self._terminal = 'ABORTED'
129	            return Command(0.0, 0.0, 'ABORTED')
130	
131	    # ---- top level ----------------------------------------------------------
132	    def _finish(self, status):
133	        self._terminal = status
134	        return Command(0.0, 0.0, status)
135	
136	    def _step(self, obs):
137	        if self._terminal is not None:
138	            return Command(0.0, 0.0, self._terminal)
139	        t = float(obs.t)
140	        self._now = t
141	        if self._t0 is None:
142	            self._t0 = t
143	        if t - self._t0 > self._budget:
144	            return self._finish('ABORTED')
145	
146	        odom = obs.odom
147	        v_meas = float(odom.v)
148	        w_meas = float(odom.w)
149	        self._travelled += max(0.0, v_meas) * DT
150	
151	        tag = self._pick_tag(obs.tags)
152	        pose = self._pose_from_tag(tag) if tag is not None else None
153	        fresh = pose is not None and self._plausible(pose)
154	        if fresh:
155	            self._cx, self._cy, self._dl, self._beta = pose
156	            self._have_pose = True
157	            self._last_tag_t = t
158	        elif self._have_pose:
159	            self._predict(v_meas, w_meas)
160	            # the tag is invisible during a sideways reposition by design: do not drop the pose
161	            if t - self._last_tag_t > LOSS_LIMIT and self._rstate is None:
162	                self._have_pose = False
163	
164	        gates = _scan_gates(obs.scan)
165	
166	        if fresh and self._mode != 'TRACK':
167	            self._mode = 'TRACK'
168	            self._dock_count = 0
169	            self._hold = 0
170	            self._blocked = 0
171	            self._rotate_only = False
172	            self._rstate = None
173	            self._reset_candidate()
174	
175	        if self._mode == 'TRACK' and self._have_pose:
176	            return self._track(fresh, gates)
177	        self._mode = 'ACQ'
178	        return self._acquire(obs, gates)
179	
180	    # ---- tag and pose -----------------------------------------------------------
181	    @staticmethod
182	    def _pick_tag(tags):
183	        for tg in tags or []:
184	            if (tg.id == TAG_ID and _finite(tg.x) and _finite(tg.z)
185	                    and _finite(tg.yaw) and tg.z > 0.2):
186	                return tg
187	        return None
188	
189	    @staticmethod
190	    def _pose_from_tag(tg):
191	        dl = YAW_SIGN * float(tg.yaw)
192	        c, s = math.cos(dl), math.sin(dl)
193	        cx = tg.x * c + tg.z * s
194	        cy = tg.z * c - tg.x * s
195	        beta = math.atan2(tg.x, tg.z)
196	        return cx, cy, dl, beta
197	
198	    @staticmethod
199	    def _plausible(pose):
200	        cx, cy, dl, _ = pose
201	        return 0.3 < cy < 5.0 and abs(dl) < 1.2 and abs(cx) < 3.0
202	
203	    def _predict(self, v, w):
204	        """Dead reckoning of the camera pose from measured odometry speeds."""
205	        c, s = math.cos(self._dl), math.sin(self._dl)
206	        d = v * DT
207	        self._cx -= d * s
208	        self._cy -= d * c
209	        self._dl -= w * DT
210	
211	    def _reset_candidate(self):
212	        self._look = 0
213	        self._approach_ticks = 0
214	
215	    # ---- track (tag visible, or dead-reckoned after a short loss) -------------
216	    def _track(self, fresh, g):
217	        cx, cy, dl = self._cx, self._cy, self._dl
218	        e = cy - D_TGT
219	        alpha = math.atan2(cx, max(cy, 0.05))
220	
221	        # 1. docking check on fresh measurements only
222	        if fresh and abs(cx) <= DOCK_LAT_TOL and abs(dl) <= DOCK_HDG_TOL \
223	                and abs(e) <= DOCK_DIST_TOL and self._rstate is None:
224	            self._dock_count += 1
225	            if self._dock_count >= DOCK_CONFIRM:
226	                return self._finish('DOCKED')
227	            return Command(0.0, 0.0, 'RUNNING')
228	        self._dock_count = 0
229	
230	        # 2. at the docking band without a tag: hold for a fresh fix (bounded)
231	        if not fresh and cy <= D_TGT + 0.05 and self._rstate is None:
232	            self._hold += 1
233	            if self._hold > HOLD_MAX_TICKS:
234	                return self._finish('ABORTED')
235	            return Command(0.0, 0.0, 'RUNNING')
236	        if fresh:
237	            self._hold = 0
238	
239	        # 3. start a reposition if the offset cannot be removed within the FOV bound
240	        if self._rstate is None:
241	            if fresh:
242	                if abs(self._beta) > FOV_ENTER:
243	                    self._rotate_only = True
244	                elif abs(self._beta) < FOV_EXIT:
245	                    self._rotate_only = False
246	                if self._rotate_only:
247	                    w = _clamp(-W_REPOS * self._beta, -W_MAX, W_MAX)
248	                    if g[2] < LIDAR_ROT_STOP:
249	                        w = 0.0
250	                    return Command(0.0, w, 'RUNNING')
251	            lim = 0.12 + BETA_MAX * math.log(max(cy, D_TGT) / D_TGT)
252	            if abs(alpha) > lim:
253	                self._rstate = 'ROT1'
254	                self._rdir = 1.0 if cx > 0.0 else -1.0
255	                self._rticks = 0
256	
257	        if self._rstate is not None:
258	            return self._reposition(g)
259	
260	        # 4. distance law with hysteresis (no forward/reverse chatter at the band edge)
261	        if self._reversing:
262	            if e > -0.03:
263	                self._reversing = False
264	        elif e < -0.06:
265	            self._reversing = True
266	        if self._reversing:
267	            v = -V_CREEP
268	        elif e > DOCK_DIST_TOL:
269	            v = _clamp(K_V * e, V_CREEP, V_FAR) * max(0.3, math.cos(dl))
270	        else:
271	            # inside the band: keep creeping while the lateral error is removed
272	            v = V_CREEP if abs(cx) > DOCK_LAT_TOL else 0.0
273	
274	        if v < 0.0 and g[1] < LIDAR_REAR_STOP:
275	            v = 0.0
276	        if v > 0.0 and g[0] < LIDAR_FWD_STOP:
277	            v = 0.0
278	            self._blocked += 1
279	            if self._blocked > BLOCK_MAX_TICKS:
280	                return self._finish('ABORTED')
281	        else:
282	            self._blocked = 0
283	
284	        # 5. lateral law: choose the tag bearing that drives alpha to zero
285	        sg = 1.0 if v >= 0.0 else -1.0
286	        beta_des = -sg * _clamp(K_ALPHA * alpha, -BETA_MAX, BETA_MAX)
287	        dl_des = _clamp(alpha - beta_des, -1.0, 1.0)
288	        w = _clamp(K_H * (dl - dl_des), -W_MAX, W_MAX)
289	        return Command(_clamp(v, -V_MAX, V_MAX), w, 'RUNNING')
290	
291	    def _reposition(self, g):
292	        """Rotate 90 deg toward the centre line, drive sideways on odometry, rotate back."""
293	        self._rticks += 1
294	        if self._rticks > REPOS_MAX_TICKS:
295	            return self._finish('ABORTED')
296	        tgt = self._rdir * math.pi / 2.0
297	        st = self._rstate
298	        if st == 'ROT1':
299	            err = self._dl - tgt
300	            if abs(err) <= math.radians(4.0):
301	                self._rstate = 'LAT'
302	            w = _clamp(K_H * err, -W_MAX, W_MAX) if g[2] >= LIDAR_ROT_STOP else 0.0
303	            return Command(0.0, w, 'RUNNING')
304	        if st == 'LAT':
305	            if self._rdir * self._cx <= 0.03:
306	                self._rstate = 'ROT2'
307	                return Command(0.0, 0.0, 'RUNNING')
308	            if g[0] < LIDAR_FWD_STOP:
309	                return self._finish('ABORTED')          # obstacle in the travel path
310	            w = _clamp(K_H * (self._dl - tgt), -W_MAX, W_MAX)
311	            return Command(REPOS_V, w, 'RUNNING')
312	        # ROT2: face the face normal again
313	        if abs(self._dl) <= math.radians(3.0):
314	            self._rstate = None
315	            self._last_tag_t = self._now
316	            return Command(0.0, 0.0, 'RUNNING')
317	        w = _clamp(K_H * self._dl, -W_MAX, W_MAX) if g[2] >= LIDAR_ROT_STOP else 0.0
318	        return Command(0.0, w, 'RUNNING')
319	
320	    # ---- acquire (no usable tag pose) -----------------------------------------
321	    def _acquire(self, obs, g):
322	        front = g[0]
323	        cand = self._best_candidate(obs.pallets, obs.odom)
324	        if cand is None:
325	            self._reset_candidate()
326	            if self._blind:
327	                if self._travelled >= BLIND_DIST or front < LIDAR_FWD_STOP:
328	                    self._blind = False
329	                else:
330	                    return Command(BLIND_V, 0.0, 'RUNNING')
331	            return self._search(g)
332	
333	        est, b, d = cand
334	        self._approach_ticks += 1
335	        w = _clamp(-K_B * b, -0.5, 0.5)
336	        if d <= PALLET_STOP_DIST:
337	            # close to the candidate: centre on it and wait for the tag
338	            self._look += 1
339	            if self._look > LOOK_TICKS:
340	                self._reject(est)
341	                return Command(0.0, 0.0, 'RUNNING')
342	            return Command(0.0, w, 'RUNNING')
343	        if front < LIDAR_FWD_STOP or self._approach_ticks > APPROACH_CAND_TICKS:
344	            self._reject(est)
345	            return Command(0.0, 0.0, 'RUNNING')
346	        self._look = 0
347	        v = _clamp(0.35 * (d - PALLET_STOP_DIST), 0.05, V_FAR) if abs(b) < 0.25 else 0.0
348	        return Command(v, w, 'RUNNING')
349	
350	    def _reject(self, est):
351	        self._rejects.append(est)
352	        self._reset_candidate()
353	
354	    def _search(self, g):
355	        if g[2] < LIDAR_ROT_STOP:
356	            if self._rot_block == 0:
357	                self._search_dir = -self._search_dir
358	            self._rot_block = (self._rot_block + 1) % 20
359	            return Command(0.0, 0.0, 'RUNNING')
360	        self._rot_block = 0
361	        return Command(0.0, SEARCH_W * self._search_dir, 'RUNNING')
362	
363	    def _best_candidate(self, pallets, odom):
364	        best = None
365	        best_s = -math.inf
366	        for det in pallets or []:
367	            if not _finite(det.score) or det.score < PALLET_MIN_SCORE or not _finite(det.u):
368	                continue
369	            b = math.atan2(det.u - IMG_W / 2.0, FX)
370	            d = self._pallet_dist(det)
371	            if d is None or d > 6.0:
372	                continue
373	            ang = float(odom.yaw) - b
374	            est = (float(odom.x) + d * math.cos(ang), float(odom.y) + d * math.sin(ang))
375	            if any(math.hypot(est[0] - r[0], est[1] - r[1]) < REJECT_RADIUS
376	                   for r in self._rejects):
377	                continue
378	            s = det.score - 0.3 * abs(b)
379	            if s > best_s:
380	                best_s = s
381	                best = (est, b, d)
382	        return best
383	
384	    @staticmethod
385	    def _pallet_dist(det):
386	        """Robust distance to the pallet face: low quantile of valid depth samples."""
387	        valid = sorted(s for s in (det.depth_samples or [])
388	                       if _finite(s) and 0.2 < s < 8.0)
389	        if len(valid) >= 3:
390	            return valid[int(0.25 * (len(valid) - 1))]
391	        if _finite(det.width_px) and det.width_px > 1.0:
392	            return PALLET_WIDTH * FX / det.width_px
393	        return None

1	"""ROS 2-like message types shared by the simulator and every controller.
2	
3	These mirror the topics of the original system:
4	  /tag_detection  -> TagDetection   (apriltag_ros, camera frame)
5	  /pallet_dets    -> PalletDetection (YOLACT bbox + depth samples)
6	  /odom           -> Odom
7	  /scan           -> Scan            (2D LiDAR)
8	  /cmd_vel        <- Command
9	"""
10	from dataclasses import dataclass, field
11	from typing import List, Optional
12	import math
13	
14	# ---- fixed platform constants (published to every designer) -------------
15	IMG_W = 640                      # RGB width [px]
16	HFOV = math.radians(69.0)        # RealSense D435i RGB horizontal FOV
17	VFOV = math.radians(42.0)
18	FX = (IMG_W / 2) / math.tan(HFOV / 2)   # focal length [px] ~ 465.9
19	CTRL_HZ = 10.0                   # controller tick rate
20	DT = 1.0 / CTRL_HZ
21	V_MAX = 0.30                     # |v| limit [m/s]
22	W_MAX = 0.60                     # |w| limit [rad/s]
23	PALLET_WIDTH = 1.20              # pocket-face width [m]
24	TAG_ID = 7                       # id of the pocket-centre tag (family 36h11, 10 cm)
25	CAM_X = 0.28                     # camera optical centre is CAM_X m ahead of base_link on the centre line
26	DOCK_DIST = 0.85                 # required camera-to-pocket-face distance at docking [m]
27	                                 # (= base_link 1.13 m from the face when aligned)
28	
29	
30	@dataclass
31	class TagDetection:
32	    id: int
33	    x: float      # lateral position of tag centre in camera frame [m], + = right
34	    z: float      # forward distance along optical axis [m]
35	    yaw: float    # angle from optical axis to the tag's inward normal [rad], + = right;
36	                  # 0 when the camera faces the tag squarely
37	    stamp: float  # time of image [s]
38	
39

41	class PalletDetection:
42	    u: float                 # bbox centre column [px] (0..639)
43	    width_px: float          # bbox width [px]
44	    score: float             # detector confidence 0..1
45	    depth_samples: List[float]   # 25 depth readings [m] around bbox centre; 0.0 = invalid pixel
46	    stamp: float
47	
48

50	class Odom:
51	    x: float      # odometry frame, starts at (0,0,0) each trial [m]
52	    y: float
53	    yaw: float    # [rad]
54	    v: float      # measured linear speed [m/s]
55	    w: float      # measured angular speed [rad/s]
56	
57	
58	@dataclass
59	class Scan:
60	    angle_min: float          # -pi
61	    angle_increment: float    # radians between beams (2 deg)
62	    ranges: List[float]       # metres, inf = no return; index 0 at angle_min, 0 rad = straight ahead
63	    range_max: float = 10.0
64	
65	
66	@dataclass
67	class Observation:
68	    t: float
69	    odom: Odom
70	    tags: List[TagDetection] = field(default_factory=list)
71	    pallets: List[PalletDetection] = field(default_factory=list)
72	    scan: Optional[Scan] = None

74

76	class Command:
77	    v: float = 0.0
